⚖️ SUPREME COURT UPDATE | BANKING & CHEQUE BOUNCE LAW
Can an Asset Reconstruction Company step into a bank's shoes in a cheque bounce case?
The Supreme Court has clarified an important legal requirement: an Asset Reconstruction Company seeking to proceed in such a case must establish that it qualifies as a "Holder in Due Course."

This development highlights the importance of legal entitlement, negotiable instruments and the requirements under cheque bounce law.
An important update for businesses, banking professionals and legal practitioners.
